_comment: Curated human-readable labels for the 4096 atlas-v3 fine cells.
Each name was hand-written against that cell's most representative
reservoir records (the members nearest its centroid), two random members,
its contrastive terms against the whole corpus and against its sibling
cells, and its axis, language and source mix over a 500,000-record
uniform reservoir of the build corpus.
Names are chosen with respect to each other: no two cells under the same
L1 parent share a name, and sibling cells are distinguished by subject.
Subject names only. A language is named only when the language itself is
the subject of the cell; a cell is never named after the language its
records happen to be in. Geography is named only when the cell itself is
Declarative curation: builds and promotion re-apply these names, and the
builder applies this file only when corpus_hash matches the build.
